verses.mystical_translation: Belonging expands when former outsiders are spoken of as born within the city of God.
The poem enters through zion, nations, rahab/egypt, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when fear, power, memory, and relationship are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
